snippet.title: Netflix Puzzled | Official Game Teaser | Netflix
snippet.description:
Introducing Netflix Puzzled, your daily destination for puzzle games on Netflix.

Solve new word, logic and visual puzzles every day and dive into puzzle collections inspired by Stranger Things, K Pop Demon Hunters, Squid Game, and more.

Netflix Puzzled is coming soon to mobile and Tudum.com: https://www.netflix.com/tudum/articles/puzzled-daily-puzzle-game-release-date

Subscribe: https://bit.ly/3Rw25E1

About Netflix Games: 
Netflix Games is part of your Netflix membership. No ads, no extra fees, no in-app purchases. Just unlimited access to exclusive mobile games you can play anytime, anywhere. With over 300 million members in 190+ countries, Netflix is bringing stories to life across TV, film, and games. Now you can play them, too.

Netflix Puzzled | Official Game Teaser | Netflix
https://www.youtube.com/@NetflixGames
